audience: operations and inventory teams that check stock, orders and suppliers in SKU.io

useCases.title: Find products and their stock
useCases.text: Search products and SKUs, then open one product with its attributes and defaults. Read its stock across warehouses.

useCases.title: Find low or empty stock by location
useCases.text: List stock quantities per warehouse location. List the warehouses with their ids and status.

useCases.title: Track sales orders
useCases.text: List sales orders with their ship-by and deliver-by dates. Open one order or its line items for status, customer and totals.

useCases.title: Review purchase orders
useCases.text: List purchase orders by status, supplier and dates. Open one order or its lines for products, quantities and unit costs.

useCases.title: Look up suppliers and customers
useCases.text: List suppliers and customers, then open one to read its contact details.
